sequential_dependency.intermediate: The vertically completed grid; cells introduced by vertical mirroring participate in the color-frequency calculation.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Apply the canonical vertical mirror completion to the input grid.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Choose the most frequent nonzero color in that intermediate (lowest color on ties) and horizontally mirror-complete only that color.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step A changes the frequency table and occupied locations consumed by Step B; on this case, skipping A changes the selected color and therefore the final writes.
